questions.stem: Why is it easier to open a door by pushing at the handle (far from the hinge) than near the hinge?

options.text: The force is larger at the handle
There is less friction at the handle
The perpendicular distance from the pivot is greater, producing a larger moment

questions.explanation: Since moment = force x distance, a greater distance from the pivot (hinge) produces a larger moment for the same applied force. This is why door handles are placed far from the hinges.
